protocol_name: Mission 22 Locked Synchronized Audiovisual Evaluation Protocol
objective: Standardized, leak-free evaluation design for future synchronized UAV search-and-rescue benchmarks

split_partitioning_rules.speaker_isolation: Strict speaker-level clustering. If multiple recordings contain the same human speaker or voice engine, all recordings for that speaker must reside in exactly one split.
split_partitioning_rules.session_isolation: Strict flight-sequence and recording-session isolation. Zero cross-split session overlap.
split_partitioning_rules.geographical_isolation: Different geographical disaster sites partitioned across splits to test domain generalization.

minimum_test_requirements.test_set_access_rule: Locked test data must NEVER be accessed during hyperparameter tuning, threshold sweeping, or feature selection.

benchmarked_paradigms: 3. Simple Heuristic OR (Alert if either triggers)
4. Simple Heuristic AND (Alert only if both trigger)

standardized_evaluation_tasks.target_definition: Ground truth is positive ONLY if BOTH visible person AND distress cry co-occur.
standardized_evaluation_tasks.evaluates: Sensor agreement and false alarm immunity.

standardized_evaluation_tasks.target_definition: Ground truth is positive if EITHER visual victim OR acoustic distress is present.
Ground truth is positive if human is visible in camera frame, regardless of acoustic state.
standardized_evaluation_tasks.evaluates: Optical detector robustness under adverse weather.

standardized_evaluation_tasks.target_definition: Ground truth is positive if distress cry is vocalized, regardless of optical visibility.
standardized_evaluation_tasks.evaluates: Acoustic keyword spotting under propeller and wind wash.

statistical_reporting_standards.primary_hypothesis_test: McNemar exact paired binomial test on matched trial predictions
statistical_reporting_standards.multiple_comparisons_control: Holm-Bonferroni step-down correction at FWER alpha = 0.05
statistical_reporting_standards.bootstrap_methodology: Two-level hierarchical cluster bootstrap (resampling flight sessions and speakers, B = 5,000)
effect_size_metrics: Empirical percentile 95% Confidence Intervals for Delta-F1
prohibited_practices: Do NOT calculate Cohen's d on bootstrap resample distributions
Do NOT assert p < 0.001 based solely on confidence intervals excluding zero
Do NOT evaluate single-modality baselines against composite multi-modal ground truth without task disaggregation
